statements.status_notes: The code is linked into bao. Review when the locked image, runtime Dockerfile, initialization policy, or OpenBao network changes, and when OpenBao ships go-jose 4.1.6 or later.
statements.impact_statement: The advisory needs an attacker-supplied RSA JWK. The initialization policy enables only the transit engine and AppRole auth, so no JWT or OIDC auth method parses external JWKs, and the listener is on the secrets network that only the API shares.
